recheck: printings differ: 8c111617 (Seed) is a; 8bed01de (Seed Saga) is still d (needs a scoped cannotBeBlockedBy restriction and a ruling on 'those players'); the condition itself is fixed by binding/E4
resolved: Seed 8c111617: unchanged (a). Seed Saga 8bed01de left: the ruling (cannot be blocked by the opponent bound by the use condition, still blockable by others) needs a restriction scoped to a blocking player; the engine has only the cannotBeBlocked keyword and restrictBlockers (party-size / speed), so the data still grants unconditional unblockability. Engine gap: a per-player 'cannot be blocked by <player>' grant.
